from app.concurrency import map_with_concurrency


# CASE py_tuple_unpack expect=pass
async def w1(items, save, parse, config):
    width = 1
    width, retries = parse(config)
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width, retries=retries)


# CASE py_augmented expect=pass
async def w2(items, save, extra):
    width = 1
    width += extra
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)


# CASE py_nonlocal_write expect=pass
async def w3(items, save, settings):
    width = 1

    def apply():
        nonlocal width
        width = settings.width

    apply()
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)


# CASE py_for_target expect=pass
async def w4(items, save, widths):
    width = 1
    for width in widths:
        if width > 4:
            break
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)


# CASE py_walrus expect=pass
async def w5(items, save, config):
    width = 1
    if (configured := config.get("width")) is not None:
        width = configured
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)


# CASE py_with_as expect=pass
async def w6(items, save, open_settings):
    width = 1
    with open_settings() as width:
        pass
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)


# CASE py_star_unpack expect=pass
async def w7(items, save, values):
    width = 1
    width, *rest = values
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)


# CASE py_end expect=pass
